title: Grow & Protect: The Money Garden
learningGoals: Explain the power of compounding in wealth creation
Visualize the long-term growth of small investments

teachingScript.teacherLine: Albert Einstein called compounding the 'Eighth Wonder of the World'. When your interest earns interest, your money grows like a garden!

data.title: Compound Interest
points: Year 10: Your money has doubled without doing anything!

teachingScript.teacherLine: In India, people love Gold and Fixed Deposits (FDs). Both grow your money, but in different ways. Gold's value changes every day, while FD is steady and safe.
Let's see the future. I have planted a tiny ₹1,000 seed for you in this garden. Move the 'Time Slider' to see how it grows over 30 years compared to just keeping it in a piggy bank!

questionPool.questionText: If interest is calculated on both the initial amount and the interest already earned, it is called _____ interest.
